notes: r2 units. Method: the MapObject vtable 0x9d3d78 and the 8 subclass vtables (scan of .rdata for 32-slot tables sharing >= 8 slots) decide the class of every slot function and of the non-virtual helpers they call on this. Merges (alias = empty class with base = canonical): Squad/GroundObject/CellObject -> Unit; Order2d/Tower -> Wall (vtable 0x9d3c88; Wall restates the full Order2d layout); MouseCr -> Order0c_a (vtable 0x9d3ab4). Base fixes: Order00/Order0b/Order0c_c/Order45 derive from MapObject (not Unit); FlagFacility derives from Facility (ctor 0x46d520, 0x79 bytes, vtable 0x9d0a80). Needs for other families: engine3d - World needs an i16 at +0x2 (world id; read through Unit+0x335, MapObject+0xa6, Place+0x1de by the save functions 0x47dbe0 / 0x481ba0 / 0x47fc80); Cell +0x8c/+0x90 are the tail/head of its Unit list (Unit+0x33d/+0x341 prev/next), Cell::clear 0x427170 (labelled List::clear, r2_lib maps it to Unit) moved to Cell; Cell +0xa4/+0xa8 are its Place list (Place+0x1e6/+0x1ea). lead / g10 owner - UnitManager (= the g_units table: DynArrayB at +0) gets save 0x47d7a0 and load_select_models 0x47dac0 (both were Units, which has a vtable at +0 and its DynArrayB at +4) and needs base DynArrayB, +0x30 i16[4], +0x38 i16[4], +0x70 select_models i32[4] (reconcile keeps 0x47d7a0 on Units until UnitManager covers +0x30/+0x38); Order (g10) is the pointee of Unit+0x2a1. lib - MouseCursor-labelled 0x4928f0 is_idle (slot 17 of vtable 0x9d3ab4) and 0x4907c0 are Order0c_a methods. player / SaveList owner - List::save_4838e0 (+0x2e, saves Profile entries) moved from UnitList to SaveList. ui - Panel::open 0x527520 (unitres.cpp) is a UnitType method. New class: UnitTemplate (dead DynGrass::copy_to 0x466320). Residual check output: World +0x2 (above) and the Unit +0 id/side straddles (explained in Unit notes).
